action: Isolated backups and a full restore test in Q1 2027

action: Joint DDoS test with Vendor X

why: Containment takes 6 hours on median; cloud logs only partly monitored
action: Automated containment playbooks; full cloud log coverage

why: Two critical providers have no security attestation this year
action: Obtain attestations; add to contract reviews
